text:
emin: quick flag  Orbitree listing wants coordinated go-live with hardware partner badge and SI link tomorrow. report blockers?

claire: press embargo set for 12:00 PT. partner insists hero + badge sync with blog publish.

rashid: ops: staging-5 has a competing deploy at 12:00 PT. risk of slot clash and CDN churn.

opsbot: feature-flag preview supported. recommend pre-stage assets behind flag and flip at embargo lift.

emin: i like the flag approach. partner can upload assets early. need S3 path + UTMs + promo code from partner.

partner-sync: assets uploaded: orbitree-hero-v1 at s3://marketplace/orbitree/hero-v1 (09:10 PT). sitemap updated.

claire: marketing: utm_source=orbitree&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=orbitree_launch; promo=ORBIT25. confirming with press.

legal: legal copy required: "Partner content provided by Orbitree." will sign off by 11:00 PT. do not flip before legal ok.

rashid: ops plan: preview 10:30 PT on staging-5, internal dry-run 11:40 PT, embargo flip 12:00 PT, CDN purge 12:15 PT (after edge maintenance at 12:05). ops will run smoke tests + SI health check after flip.

opsbot: calendar reminders set: preview 10:30 PT, dry-run 11:40 PT, flip 12:00 PT. rollback window 3m.

emin: SI checklist note  whitelist partner egress IPs and verify token exchange. sample SI check: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.orbitree.com/health | jq -r .status` expecting "ok".

partner-sync: partner pushed minor mobile crop patch at 09:45 PT. preview link: https://staging-5.redwood.ai/orbitree/hero-preview

claire: saw preview, mobile crop good. marketing will hold blog PR and trigger publish on embargo flip.

rashid: ops will be in #release-war-room for dry-run and live flip. we'll avoid CDN purge during maintenance and run at 12:15 PT.

legal: signed off copy posted in assets doc at 11:00 PT.

opsbot: dry-run successful at 11:40 PT. ready for embargo flip.

emin: final owners: assets=partner-sync, ops=rashid, press=claire, legal=legal, SI=emin. one-line runbook:
- 09:10 PT: partner asset upload
- 10:30 PT: ops preview (staging-5)
- 11:40 PT: internal dry-run
- 12:00 PT: embargo lift -> flip flag -> publish blog
- 12:15 PT: CDN purge -> verify analytics events and SI health
- 12:30 PT: post-launch verification

claire: i'll watch press channel and confirm publish on flip. will notify if any timing change.

rashid: standing by. reopen thread only if asset or SI problems. good luck team :rocket:
